ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Islamic Morality? (1 mark)

   B. Use Significance of Islamic Morality to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Significance of Islamic Morality has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Islamic Morality.
